author.name: Reliability Ruth
author.role: Develops the end-user applications and services that integrate ML models. Handles model deployment, configuration, and continuous monitoring of real-world performance. Employs feedback loops to facilitate iterative improvements and system reliability.

challenge.name: The Inconsistent Checks
challenge.description: #data_dave# insists on keeping the quality checks manually done to control costs. #reliability_ruth# argues for full automation to ensure consistent results.

output.content: Manual quality checks are not an option for me, {reliability_ruth}. I understand that costs are a concern, but the reliability of our models is non-negotiable. If we continue with manual checks, we risk inconsistent results, which could compromise the entire system. I will not accept any solution that does not ensure the highest level of reliability. The quality checks must be fully automated with governed tools to maintain the integrity of our models. This is a line I cannot cross.
output.reclassify_reason: The author explicitly states that manual quality checks are not acceptable and sets a clear boundary that must not be crossed.
